Marriott International Unveils MARRIOTT MEDIA: A New Era in Travel Marketing
Marriott International has officially introduced MARRIOTT MEDIA, marking a transformative shift in how brands connect with consumers throughout the travel journey. This groundbreaking media network is designed specifically for travelers, setting it apart from traditional advertising models by focusing on customer-centric, context-driven engagement.
Unlike conventional media platforms, MARRIOTT MEDIA places the traveler’s journey at its core, ensuring that brands reach customers at precisely the right moments. By strategically integrating both digital and physical touchpoints, MARRIOTT MEDIA delivers relevant messages when travelers are most receptive. This innovative approach uses Marriott’s extensive data capabilities to tailor content that resonates with travelers’ individual needs, interests, and behaviors.
Targeted Engagement Through First-Party Data
At the heart of MARRIOTT MEDIA is Marriott’s rich first-party data. The network taps into the vast Marriott Bonvoy membership base, which includes nearly 237 million members, and utilizes over 200 targetable attributes to fine-tune the advertising experience. With a portfolio that spans nearly 9,500 properties globally, Marriott is uniquely positioned to combine demographic insights with detailed guest behavior, travel intent, and personal passions.
Through this data-driven targeting, MARRIOTT MEDIA ensures that brand messages reach the right audience at the most opportune time. Whether it’s a traveler searching for a destination or someone planning a future trip, the network provides marketers with the tools to deliver highly personalized content. By analyzing these data points, the platform enables seamless integration across Marriott’s vast array of touchpoints, offering a consistent and relevant brand experience throughout a guest’s journey.
Bridging the Gap Between Advertisers and Travelers
One of the standout features of MARRIOTT MEDIA is its ability to merge advertiser content with Marriott’s own native content. This synergy creates a seamless advertising experience, positioning brand messaging alongside trusted Marriott content. From personalized pre-arrival recommendations to curated in-room experiences, the network ensures that ads appear in spaces where travelers are already engaged. This connection doesn’t stop at check-out; MARRIOTT MEDIA extends the experience by re-engaging guests after their stay with tailored offers, ensuring the relationship with the brand remains active long after they’ve left the property.
This connected journey model is not just about impressions but about delivering value through compelling offers and memorable moments. By focusing on high-trust, high-attention spaces within Marriott’s ecosystem, MARRIOTT MEDIA provides advertisers with a chance to create a lasting impact that resonates with customers across multiple touchpoints.
The Power of Marriott Bonvoy TV: A Storytelling Opportunity
Among the most compelling features of MARRIOTT MEDIA is its unique integration with Marriott Bonvoy TV. This feature offers brands an opportunity to connect with travelers through long-form, engaging content that plays throughout their stay. By leveraging the power of storytelling, Marriott Bonvoy TV offers a powerful platform for advertisers to build meaningful connections with guests. This in-room content placement enables brands to reach guests when they are most relaxed and receptive to curated experiences, adding a layer of narrative that enhances the brand’s messaging.
With more than 30 hotel brands within Marriott’s portfolio, MARRIOTT MEDIA provides access to some of the most loyal and high-spending travelers worldwide. These guests tend to stay longer, spend more, and remain highly engaged with the brands they trust. For media buyers and brand strategists, hospitality media is no longer an afterthought. Instead, it’s becoming a critical growth engine that delivers significant returns on investment.
A Global, Authentic Experience
As Marriott plans to expand MARRIOTT MEDIA into global markets, one key differentiator will remain at the forefront: authenticity. The network is committed to delivering culturally relevant content that resonates with local audiences. By prioritizing localized experiences and cultural context, Marriott ensures that its media offerings feel genuine and relevant to travelers from all corners of the globe.
In addition, Marriott places a strong emphasis on brand safety. All branded content within MARRIOTT MEDIA is carefully curated to ensure that it aligns with the values of the Marriott brand and the expectations of its guests. This attention to detail ensures that brands can confidently advertise within Marriott’s trusted ecosystem, knowing that their content will be presented in a safe, respectful environment.
“Today’s travelers expect personalization and welcome thoughtful discovery. MAR
RIOTT MEDIA
is designed to enrich, not interrupt, serving guests content, recommendations, and offers in ways that feel natural, relevant, and aligned with their travel experience,” said
Peggy Roe
, Executive Vice President and Chief Customer Officer at Marriott International. “I’m excited to announce
Chris Norton
, Senior Vice President of Marketing, Data Activation & Personalization, will lead this bold initiative and serve as the General Manager for MAR
RIOTT MEDIA
.”
Norton
added: “Our goal is to offer select brand partners the opportunity to create deeper engagement with customers through the lens of travel and our brands. Through sophisticated measurement, including brand lift and awareness studies, attributable conversions, and advanced modeling, we empower our brand partners to align their campaigns with our travelers, ensuring meaningful engagement at every touchpoint.”
The Future of Hospitality Media
MARRIOTT MEDIA represents the future of hospitality marketing. With its data-driven approach, seamless integration across touchpoints, and emphasis on authenticity, the platform is poised to become a leader in travel advertising. By tapping into Marriott’s vast global network, MARRIOTT MEDIA enables brands to reach an engaged and affluent audience at every stage of the travel journey.
As the platform continues to grow and scale, it will undoubtedly reshape how marketers engage with travelers. Through thoughtful design, personalized messaging, and innovative storytelling, MARRIOTT MEDIA offers a new chapter in the evolution of travel marketing – one that is deeply connected to the traveler’s experience and centered on delivering real value.
With MARRIOTT MEDIA, Marriott International is setting a new standard for how brands can effectively connect with their audience while enhancing the overall travel experience. The platform’s potential to drive growth for both advertisers and the company itself is limitless, positioning Marriott as a trailblazer in the world of hospitality media.

Marriott Launches MARRIOTT MEDIA As A Powerful New Platform That Bridges The Gap Between Brands And Travelers With Unmatched Precision In Global Travel

Travel And Tour World
.

Holiday Inn Club Vacations Unveils First Phase of The Residences at Orange Lake Resort
Holiday Inn Club Vacations Incorporated (HICV), a prominent international vacation ownership company, celebrated a significant achievement with the ribbon-cutting ceremony for the first phase of its luxurious expansion at The Residences at Orange Lake Resort. The event marks a key milestone for the company and highlights its commitment to providing high-end, private vacation experiences for multi-generational families and travelers.
This expansion features the completion of three opulent six-bedroom homes and a fully furnished model home, designed to provide unparalleled comfort and style. These new residences are designed to cater to families looking for a spacious, luxurious getaway with all the amenities necessary for a truly memorable vacation. The homes are now ready to host guests, offering them a unique opportunity to enjoy the beauty and luxury of a private retreat.
The ribbon-cutting ceremony took place nearly two years after the project’s groundbreaking on August 8, 2023, and was attended by key figures in the industry. Notable attendees included John Staten, President and CEO of HICV; Jorge Reyes, Regional Vice President of Operations for HICV; Jason Gamel, President and CEO of the American Resort Development Association , Mike Campbell, Vice President of Sales for HICV; and Robert Agrusa, President and CEO of the Central Florida Hotel and Lodging Association Their remarks during the ceremony highlighted the company’s focus on enhancing the vacation experience and strengthening its position in the luxury vacation ownership sector.
Each residence spans an impressive 5,575 square feet, offering families ample space and an abundance of luxury features. These expansive homes are built with comfort, family connection, and high-end living in mind. The six-bedroom, six-bathroom layout includes dual master suites, ensuring ample privacy and relaxation for everyone. The living areas are designed to be both comfortable and luxurious, with large entertainment spaces complete with 85″ TVs and surround sound systems for a home-theater-like experience.
For those seeking relaxation and recreation, the residences feature a private screened-in pool with a sun shelf, a hot tub, and a fire pit area, perfect for enjoying the warm Florida evenings. Additionally, the homes are equipped with game rooms and fitness rooms, offering entertainment options for all ages. The chef’s kitchen is a focal point of each residence, with an expansive island and seating, as well as a spacious dining area that can accommodate up to 20 people. The outdoor kitchen and covered patio provide the ideal setting for alfresco dining and social gatherings in the Florida sunshine.
In keeping with modern conveniences, each home is equipped with state-of-the-art smart home technology, allowing guests to control various systems within the home for maximum comfort and ease. For added convenience, each residence comes with its own personal golf cart, offering easy transportation around the expansive resort.
“This is more than just the completion of four stunning homes—it’s the realization of a bold vision to reimagine how families travel together,” said
Staten
. “We believe that multi-generational travel is the future, and The Residences represent our ongoing commitment to leading that movement by offering innovative, spacious accommodations at the very resort where our company began more than 40 years ago.”
The model home is currently available for preview, giving prospective guests the opportunity to explore the new luxury residences before booking their stay. The first three homes are set to welcome guests later this summer, with Holiday Inn Club members receiving priority booking access. This marks a new era for Orange Lake Resort, further elevating the guest experience with the addition of these luxury residences.
Orange Lake Resort, established in 1982 by Holiday Inn founder Kemmons Wilson, has grown into a premier destination covering 1,100 acres. The resort features over 2,400 villas across four distinct villages and offers an array of amenities that cater to every type of vacationer. The property boasts a lazy river, four golf courses, multiple dining options, mini golf, sports courts, and much more, ensuring that guests have everything they need for an unforgettable stay.
As the first phase of The Residences at Orange Lake Resort opens its doors, it is clear that Holiday Inn Club Vacations is continuing to set new standards for luxury and comfort in the vacation ownership industry. With its focus on providing a private, high-end vacation experience, the company is sure to attract discerning travelers seeking the perfect place to relax and unwind with family and loved ones.
This new addition to the resort is not just a testament to the company’s growth but also an affirmation of its commitment to providing exceptional vacation experiences for families around the world. As more residences become available, it’s expected that The Residences at Orange Lake Resort will become a top destination for those seeking a luxurious, multi-generational vacation retreat.

Travel And Tour World

JW Marriott has made its much-awaited debut in Greece with the opening of the JW Marriott Crete Resort & Spa, a luxurious beach destination set to redefine high-end hospitality in the Mediterranean. Located near the charming town of Chania, on Crete’s stunning coastline, this is the brand’s first Mediterranean resort, offering an exclusive escape that celebrates the island’s rich cultural heritage and natural beauty.
A Truly Mediterranean Experience
The resort, which spans over 100 acres of pristine coastline, offers 160 elegantly designed rooms, suites, and villas. Each accommodation provides sweeping views of the Aegean Sea, with many including private pools, ensuring guests enjoy an intimate, exclusive experience. The property has been carefully designed to blend with Crete’s natural landscape, featuring elements that complement the surrounding beauty.
The JW Marriott Crete Resort & Spa is an example of understated luxury. It’s not only about impeccable service but also creating a sense of presence—inviting guests to relax, connect with their surroundings, and experience Crete in a way that’s both serene and culturally enriching.
Design That Honors Nature
Crafted by the renowned Athens-based design studio Block722, the resort is a testament to contemporary elegance that embraces the surrounding landscape. The architecture blends seamlessly with the environment through the use of local materials such as marble, wood, and stone, as well as green roofs and olive groves that echo the region’s traditional natural beauty.
Inside, the design is sophisticated yet organic, with soft, flowing lines and a color palette drawn from the Mediterranean—terracotta, olive green, sandy neutrals, and earthy stone tones. This calm, tactile design approach creates a tranquil ambiance, allowing guests to fully immerse themselves in the peace of their surroundings.
Sustainability is at the heart of the resort’s development, with the use of geothermal and solar energy, as well as systems that recover heat from air conditioning for water heating. These green initiatives ensure the property minimizes its environmental impact while creating a truly harmonious relationship between luxury and nature.
Celebrating Crete’s Culinary Riches
Culinary excellence is one of the core elements of the JW Marriott experience, and the Crete Resort & Spa certainly lives up to this reputation. The resort boasts six exceptional dining venues, each celebrating the island’s fresh, seasonal ingredients. The centerpiece of the resort’s culinary offering is the JW Garden, where guests can explore the flavors of fresh herbs and vegetables like thyme, oregano, and capers, which are incorporated into dishes and cocktails throughout the resort.
The resort’s signature dining venues include ANOEE, a traditional open-fire Cretan restaurant, led by celebrated chef Manolis Papoutsakis, who brings island ingredients and ancient cooking techniques to life. Õnalos offers a refined sea-to-table experience, celebrating the best catches from the Aegean Sea, while Cuccagna serves rustic Italian dishes with a modern twist. Fayi presents Mediterranean sharing plates in a cozy, welcoming setting, perfect for groups.
For guests looking for more relaxed dining, Suncti by the Pool and Eēxis offer lighter fare in peaceful surroundings. The resort’s collaboration with the famous Line Athens bar further elevates the guest experience with its bespoke mixology program. This program focuses on using Cretan herbs and botanicals, elevating local flavors with innovative cocktail-making techniques.
The resort also features Europe’s first JW Market, a vibrant space that combines café and retail elements. This unique venue showcases local products, emphasizing the brand’s commitment to well-being and authentic experiences, all within a stylish setting.
A Wellness Sanctuary
Wellness at the JW Marriott Crete Resort & Spa is defined by a balance between traditional Cretan healing practices and modern wellness therapies. The resort’s ANOSEAS Spa offers a range of treatments that integrate the island’s ancient wellness rituals with contemporary practices, creating a healing environment designed to nurture both body and mind.
The spa includes five treatment rooms, hydrotherapy experiences, and a beauty room, with additional wellness facilities like a yoga deck and panoramic swimming pools. A state-of-the-art fitness center ensures guests can maintain their wellness routines while enjoying breathtaking views of the Aegean Sea.
For families, the resort offers a range of engaging experiences at the Phestos Den, powered by Worldwide Kids. This area is designed for cultural discovery, creative play, and educational fun, with spaces that encourage exploration and learning. Families can also enjoy curated cultural excursions to explore Crete’s historic monasteries and archaeological treasures, adding a deeper connection to the island’s vibrant heritage.
An Immersive Destination for Families and Multi-Generational Travelers
JW Marriott Crete Resort & Spa is ideal for multi-generational travelers, offering a variety of experiences for all ages. For younger guests, the resort provides enriching experiences that encourage creativity and curiosity, with hands-on activities and a dedicated vegetable garden where children can connect with nature.
Beyond the resort, families can embark on bespoke sea-based adventures, exploring the island’s crystal-clear waters, or venture on cultural excursions to ancient sites. These unique experiences ensure that each guest, whether young or old, leaves with cherished memories and a deeper understanding of Crete’s timeless charm.
An Oasis of Luxury and Sustainability
The JW Marriott Crete Resort & Spa is a perfect blend of modern luxury, thoughtful design, and sustainable practices. From its stunning architecture that complements the island’s natural beauty to its commitment to sustainability through renewable energy and eco-friendly practices, the resort offers a one-of-a-kind experience that immerses guests in both luxury and nature.
Whether for a romantic getaway, a family vacation, or a wellness retreat, this new Mediterranean destination promises an unforgettable experience that allows guests to truly connect with the essence of Crete while indulging in the world-class service and amenities of JW Marriott.

In a historic achievement, Larnaca and Paphos airports have handled over 4 million passengers in the first five months of 2025, marking a 12.02% increase compared to the same period in 2024. This milestone highlights the robust recovery and remarkable growth within Cyprus’ aviation sector, signaling the island’s rising prominence in global travel. With Larnaca seeing a 19% boost in passenger volume and Paphos experiencing a surge in international connectivity, both airports are on track to maintain their upward momentum throughout the year.
Larnaca and Paphos airports have achieved an impressive milestone, handling over 4 million passengers in the first five months of 2025. This remarkable achievement marks the first time in the airports’ histories that such a feat has been accomplished, reflecting a robust recovery and strong growth within Cyprus’ aviation sector.
According to a statement from the Ministry of Transport, Communications, and Works, the two airports combined saw a 12.02% increase in passenger traffic compared to the same period in 2024. This growth is a significant indicator of Cyprus’ resurgent aviation industry, bolstered by increasing travel demand and a strong rebound in international tourism.
May 2025: A Landmark Month for Cyprus Airports
In May alone, Larnaca and Paphos airports welcomed 1,282,882 passengers, a notable 12.47% increase compared to May 2024. This surge in passenger numbers highlights the continued momentum of Cyprus’ aviation recovery as international flights continue to soar in popularity.
Larnaca Airport, the larger of the two, saw a remarkable 19% increase in passenger traffic during this period, signaling a significant rise in demand for its routes. Meanwhile, Paphos Airport, despite experiencing a slight decline of 1.36% in passenger volume compared to 2024 figures, remains an essential gateway for travelers to and from Cyprus, contributing to the overall growth of the country’s aviation sector.
Surge in Aircraft Movements Reflects Growing International Connectivity
The increase in passenger numbers was mirrored by a surge in aircraft movements, which rose by 10.25% compared to 2024, reaching a total of 9,518 flights. This rise in flight activity underscores the expanding international connectivity that both airports are offering.
Larnaca Airport, in particular, experienced significant growth in flight routes to Israel, the United Kingdom, Poland, Germany, and Armenia. These routes have become vital to the airport’s traffic increase, reinforcing the airport’s role as a key hub in the Eastern Mediterranean.
Paphos Airport, on the other hand, saw a positive growth trajectory in routes to the United Kingdom, Poland, Hungary, Germany, and Jordan. This expansion reflects Paphos’ growing appeal as a leisure destination, attracting travelers from across Europe and beyond.
Changes in Passenger Traffic: Routes with Declines
While Cyprus’ airports are seeing overall growth, certain routes have experienced declines. Larnaca Airport saw a drop in traffic from France, Jordan, Norway, Switzerland, and Belgium. Similarly, Paphos Airport faced reduced traffic from Greece, Romania, France, Estonia, and Israel. These decreases reflect broader regional shifts in travel preferences and changing global circumstances but do not detract from the airports’ overall upward trajectory.
Cyprus Aviation Industry on the Path to Recovery
The exceptional performance of Larnaca and Paphos airports in 2025 demonstrates the resilience and recovery of the Cypriot aviation sector. The 12.02% increase in passengers year-over-year, coupled with the surge in flight operations, paints a clear picture of Cyprus’ vital role in the global travel landscape.
The strong growth in passenger numbers and the consistent expansion of flight routes signal an optimistic outlook for the remainder of 2025. The Ministry of Transport, Communications, and Works continues to monitor the dynamic developments in the aviation sector, ensuring that Cyprus remains a key player in the international tourism and travel markets.
The record-breaking performance of Larnaca and Paphos airports provides compelling evidence that the Cypriot aviation industry is not only recovering but thriving, offering an excellent foundation for continued growth in the years to come.
Conclusion
Larnaca and Paphos airports have shattered records by handling over 4 million passengers in the first five months of 2025, reflecting a 12.02% growth and a strong recovery in Cyprus’ aviation sector.
The impressive performance of Larnaca and Paphos airports in the first five months of 2025 marks a pivotal moment for Cyprus’ aviation sector. With over 4 million passengers handled, representing a significant year-on-year increase, both airports have demonstrated their resilience and ability to adapt to the growing demand for air travel.
As the aviation industry continues to recover globally, Cyprus is positioned as a key player, with increasing connectivity and a growing number of international routes. While some routes have experienced slight declines, the overall trend points to continued success and a positive outlook for the remainder of 2025.
The strong recovery of these airports not only highlights the vitality of the Cypriot tourism sector but also reinforces the importance of strategic investments in infrastructure and international partnerships. As the aviation industry evolves, Larnaca and Paphos airports are sure to play a crucial role in shaping the future of Cyprus’ travel and tourism economy.

Castle Peak Holdings has done it again. This time, the investment powerhouse has raised three hundred fifteen million USD to scale the beloved Trailborn brand even further. And in a bold move, they’ve officially bought Snow King Resort, one of the most iconic properties in Jackson Hole. The announcement comes at a time when outdoor travel in America reaches an all-time high, and demand for nature-based experiences has never been stronger.
But why now? Why Snow King? And how will this transform the Trailborn portfolio? With Americans craving wide-open spaces, guided adventures, and authentic stays, Castle Peak is seizing the moment.
This isn’t just a hotel acquisition—it’s a signal that outdoor hospitality is the future. What happens when millions of travelers shift from city views to mountain escapes? Castle Peak has the answer—and it’s just getting started. The full story behind this game-changing investment is unfolding now. Castle Peak Holdings raises $315M to grow Trailborn hospitality brand, acquires Snow King Resort in Wyoming, and reshapes outdoor travel across the US.
Castle Peak Holdings is rewriting the rules of outdoor hospitality—and travelers are paying attention. The investment firm behind the fast-growing Trailborn hotel brand has just closed its second investment vehicle with $315 million in committed capital. The move not only solidifies investor confidence in outdoor-focused travel, but it also signals a major evolution in how Americans experience nature.
With its first acquisition from this new fund, Castle Peak has purchased the renowned
Snow King Resort
in
Jackson Hole, Wyoming
, expanding its footprint into one of the most iconic adventure destinations in the United States. This marks another bold step in Trailborn’s mission: to deliver high-quality, design-forward stays in outdoor destinations where elevated hospitality has traditionally been missing.
Trailborn is not just another boutique hotel brand. It’s a purpose-built hospitality platform with a clear identity—experiential travel that puts nature and local culture at the heart of the stay. And now, backed by Castle Peak’s newest round of capital, it’s about to grow bigger and faster than ever before.
Launched in 2021
, Castle Peak was founded by two Goldman Sachs alumni with a sharp eye for niche market opportunities. Their approach is anything but generic. Using a highly focused investment playbook, Castle Peak creates and scales hospitality platforms by identifying supply-demand gaps in unique corners of the real estate world. With Trailborn, they’re proving how underserved outdoor markets are ready for a better guest experience.
Since its debut,
Trailborn has expanded rapidly
, with five hotels already open and more on the way. Properties include:
Trailborn Rocky Mountains & Outpost
in Estes Park, Colorado
Trailborn Highlands
in the Blue Ridge Mountains of North Carolina
Trailborn Surf & Sound
in Wrightsville Beach, North Carolina
Trailborn Grand Canyon
in Williams, Arizona
Each location has been thoughtfully curated to reflect the essence of its surrounding environment, offering not just rooms, but fully immersive stays that blend nature, design, and personalized local expertise.
What sets Trailborn apart is its
“one at a time” approach
—developing each property individually with attention to local detail and guest experience. From guided excursions led by passionate locals to amenities that go beyond basics, every Trailborn stay is designed to help travelers connect meaningfully with their destination.
Moreover, the company’s long-term agreement with
Marriott
, secured in 2024, means Trailborn will now be part of one of the world’s most recognized hospitality systems. This partnership not only expands the brand’s reach but also provides loyal Marriott travelers with new outdoor-inspired stays, seamlessly integrated into the loyalty program they already trust.
The Snow King Resort acquisition marks a strategic leap.
Jackson Hole, long known for luxury ranches and rugged beauty, is a bucket-list destination for adventurers and nature lovers. By adding this iconic property to its portfolio, Trailborn plants its flag in one of America’s most premium outdoor markets—bringing its signature mix of approachable luxury and locally rooted design to a whole new level.
But this is just the beginning. Over the next year, Trailborn plans to debut additional properties in
Mendocino, California
, and expand within
Jackson Hole
, turning the brand into a national network of elevated outdoor escapes.
As more travelers crave authenticity, nature, and high-quality experiences outside urban centers, Trailborn’s rise reflects a broader trend.
Outdoor travel is booming
, especially among younger, experience-driven demographics. These travelers want curated stays that feel human, meaningful, and deeply tied to place—not just another cookie-cutter hotel.
Trailborn meets this need head-on. Its guided experiences, wellness amenities, and community engagement initiatives offer guests more than just a room—they offer connection. And in a post-pandemic travel landscape, that’s exactly what people are looking for.
For
Castle Peak
, this success confirms that its investment thesis is working. Real estate value creation tied to brand value creation is delivering results, and the market is responding. Raising $315 million in just four months highlights investor trust in both the model and the execution behind it.
With outdoor travel continuing to grow, Castle Peak and Trailborn are well-positioned to shape the future of the hospitality industry—not by following trends, but by creating destinations that answer a deeper call.
Because in today’s world, travelers aren’t just looking to get away. They’re looking to reconnect—with nature, with people, and with themselves. And Trailborn, backed by Castle Peak’s bold vision, is helping them do exactly that—
one unforgettable place at a time
.

‘Goodbye…’: Chilling Instagram Post by British Flyer Moments Before Air India Flight Goes Viral
“It’s our last night in India"
By
Priya Singh
June 13, 2025
>
      Tech
London-based yoga instructor and spiritual guide Jamie Meek, along with his partner Fiongal Greenlaw-Meek, had just wrapped up a deeply memorable trip to Gujarat before boarding the ill-fated Air India Flight AI171. The couple had been documenting their experiences on Instagram, sharing heartfelt stories from their final night in India.
🤳Final Instagram Story from Jamie Ray Meek, a British passenger aboard Air India Flight 171, shared just before takeoff.
Meek is listed on the manifest as GBR 149261531.
Flight later crashed near Ahmedabad.
https://t.co/6UIXDm36zF
— the Pulse (@thePulseGlobal)
Late Wednesday night, Jamie posted a reflection on their journey, calling it a “mind-blowing” and “magical experience.” In one of his stories, he wrote, “It’s our last night in India,” tagging The House of MG, a heritage hotel in Ahmedabad, and captioned a glimpse of it with “This hotel.”
ALSO SEE:
OpenAI CEO Sam Altman Discloses ChatGPT's Energy and Water Usage Per Query
Their final evening was spent soaking in the ambiance of the historic property and enjoying a traditional Gujarati thali, which Jamie described as “a perfect way to round up the trip.” The couple, who frequently share wellness content through Jamie’s London-based centre, The Wellness Foundry, seemed particularly moved by the cultural richness of their travels.
The flight, which departed from at 13:38 hrs, was carrying 242 passengers and crew members on board the Boeing 787-8 aircraft. Of these, 169 are Indian nationals, 53 are British nationals, 1 Canadian national and 7 Portuguese nationals.
📹 Vijay Soneji
pic.twitter.com/ccboJpr23g
— The Hindu (@the_hindu)
In another Instagram story video, Jamie elaborated on the emotional weight of the experience, saying, “There’s been too much, hasn’t there not to document and it would be so nice to remember this and share this with everybody because we really have been on quite a journey. Then spending the last night here in this amazing hotel and we’ve just had the most delicious food. It was the perfect way to round up the trip. So yeah, excited to share it all with you.”
Tragically, just hours after that post, on the morning of June 12, 2025, Air India Flight AI171 crashed shortly after takeoff from Ahmedabad’s Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel International Airport. The Boeing 787 Dreamliner was en route to London Gatwick and carried approximately 242 people. It plunged into the Megh Nagar area near the airport perimeter within minutes of departure. Only one person survived, marking the event as one of India’s deadliest aviation disasters in recent history.
Eyewitnesses from nearby areas such as Vastrapur reported thick plumes of smoke and blazing flames rising from the crash site, causing widespread panic. Emergency services, including firefighters and medical teams, responded swiftly, launching rescue and relief operations while authorities began investigating the cause of the crash. The loss has sent shockwaves through communities both in India and abroad—especially for those who had followed Jamie and Fiongal’s journey so closely online, never imagining it would end in such tragedy.

This Unused Art Is The Coolest
Dragon Age: The Veilguard
’s Party Has Ever Looked
A massive concept art drop includes some promo material that BioWare never used
By
Kenneth Shepard
Published
an hour ago
We may earn a commission from links on this page.
Start Slideshow
Start Slideshow
When a game is in the works as long as
Dragon Age: The Veilguard
was, it’s bound to have a ton of unused assets and concept art. Developers like BioWare go through so many artistic iterations of a game within normal development cycles, so you can imagine how many more a game like
The Veilguard
had when it was rebooted twice and
in development for a decade
. The cool thing is that when we do get a concept art drop, we get an in-depth look at what could have been, or in this case, we get some pretty rad art of characters we already know and love, which we can use as phone wallpapers or possibly print out to display as decoration.
Advertisement
Volta Studio, a company that makes concept art for games and movies, recently updated its
ArtStation
account with several pieces from its work on
The Veilguard
. If you’ve played the game or read its art book, a fair bit of this will be familiar to you. However, there’s one set I want to draw attention to, and it’s the character posters Volta worked on for each party member, as well as for Varric, the player’s dwarven peepaw, and the elven trickster god Solas.
A lot of
The Veilguard
’s marketing campaign focused on the party above all else.
The characters you befriend and woo
are typically the draw of BioWare’s games, so it makes sense that the studio would want to spotlight them as much as possible in
trailers
,
podcasts
, and promotional art. At some point, this included some incredible character art for the team that is maybe some of the best art we’ve ever had of the group. Each piece captures a particular character’s personality, aesthetics, and story in one clean shot.
To call out a few favorites, I really love the Solas, Davrin, and Emmrich pieces. The cool blue tones on Solas give him an air of god-like power, and his dread wolf namesakes appear alongside him as loyal pets. He wasn’t intimidating when he debuted in 2014’s
Inquisition
, but he sure is here. Davrin is my
Veilguard
boo, but I promise I’m not being biased giving him a shoutout here. He and our griffon son Assan look fucking sick here, with the beast perched on the Warden’s back and defending him with his wing. That being said, I think the Emmrich piece is my favorite. Seeing the mage surrounded by adoring skeletons, including one that lovingly caresses his face, captures both his love of necromancy and his gentle romantic side. Click through to see all nine.
All this concept art is cool to look back on, but it does bring to mind the sad state of BioWare after publisher EA
gutted the studio
following
The Veilguard
’s disappointing sales. Those that remain are currently working on the fifth
Mass Effect
game.

content: Israel Apologises For Map Showing J&K As Part Of Pakistan After Indians Slam ‘Friend’s Blunder’ Last Updated: June 14, 2025, 11:05 IST The Israel Defense Forces admitted its graphic “failed to precisely depict borders” after a social media backlash over showing Jammu and Kashmir outside India The IDF has apologised for a graphic that misrepresented Indian borders. The Israel Defense Forces (IDF) has issued a public apology after posting a map on social media that inaccurately depicted India’s borders, showing Jammu and Kashmir as part of Pakistan. The post, shared on X (formerly Twitter) late Friday evening, was part of a broader message highlighting Tel Aviv’s view of Iran as a “global threat". But it quickly sparked a wave of criticism from Indian users who flagged the erroneous map and demanded immediate correction. The backlash prompted the Israeli military to respond directly to one of the complaints, saying: “This post is an illustration of the region. This map fails to precisely depict borders. We apologise for any offense caused." The clarification came roughly 90 minutes after the original tweet went up and was addressed to an X account called “Indian Right Wing Community", which had publicly highlighted the map and tagged Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu. “Now you understand why India remains neutral. In diplomacy, no one’s really your friend." Several others followed, urging the IDF to delete, correct, and repost the map. Some pointed out that the depiction undermined India’s territorial integrity and questioned why a close ally would make such a mistake. The incident also drew political reactions back home, with Congress leader Pawan Khera criticising the government over its close ties with Israel, suggesting that such lapses reflect poorly on India’s diplomatic positioning and its claims of global influence. As of now, the Indian government has not officially responded to the incident. The Map And What Sparked The Backlash The map was part of a tweet that read: “Iran is a global threat. Israel is not the end goal, it’s only the beginning. We had no other choice but to act." The graphic in question was intended to show the range of Iranian missiles, with concentric red circles emanating from Iran and shading over a wide swathe of territory, covering Saudi Arabia, Libya, Ethiopia, India, China, Kazakhstan, Romania, Bulgaria, Russia, Turkey, and others. However, the map’s depiction of India’s borders was incorrect, showing Jammu and Kashmir outside the country, effectively implying it was Pakistani territory. India’s Firm Stand On J&K India has repeatedly made its position clear that Jammu & Kashmir and Ladakh, including areas illegally occupied by Pakistan and China for decades, are integral and inalienable parts of the country. Prime Minister Narendra Modi reiterated this stand just last month in the wake of the Pahalgam terror attack and during the launch of Operation Sindoor, India’s retaliatory strike on terror infrastructure across the border. Why The Map Error Stings The cartographic error has caused particular dismay because of the strong and carefully nurtured relationship between India and Israel in recent years. In 2017, Prime Minister Narendra Modi became the first Indian Prime Minister to visit Israel, a landmark trip that cemented ties in areas such as agriculture, cybersecurity, defence, and trade. Today, India is among Israel’s top five trading partners, alongside the United States, the United Kingdom, Hong Kong, and China. It is also one of the largest buyers of Israeli military equipment. Against this backdrop, the use of an incorrect map by the Israeli military, whether accidental or careless, has struck a nerve in Indian strategic circles and among the public. Israel-Iran Conflict The incident comes amid a sharp escalation between Israel and Iran. On June 13, Israel launched Operation Rising Lion, targeting key Iranian military and nuclear facilities, including the Natanz site. In retaliation, Iran fired over 150 ballistic missiles and drones at Israeli cities such as Tel Aviv and Jerusalem, marking one of the most direct confrontations between the two nations. While both sides reported casualties and damage, the broader concern is the risk of a full-scale regional conflict, with global powers urging restraint. Tonix Pharmaceuticals stock falls after announcing $225 million share offerings
View all comments (0)
0
TNXP
-5.53%
Investing.com -- Tonix Pharmaceuticals Holding Corp (NASDAQ:
TNXP
) stock dropped 10.8% after the company announced plans to sell up to $225 million in common stock through two separate offerings.
In a regulatory filing on June 11, 2025, Tonix revealed it has entered into a Sales Agreement with A.G.P./Alliance Global Partners (NYSE:
GLP
) to offer up to $150 million of its common stock in an "at the market offering." The company will pay A.G.P. a 3.0% commission on gross proceeds from each sale.
Simultaneously, Tonix entered into a Purchase Agreement with Lincoln Park Capital Fund, allowing the company to sell up to an additional $75 million in newly issued shares. This agreement replaces a prior arrangement between Tonix and Lincoln Park from August 2022.
Under the Lincoln Park agreement, Tonix can direct Lincoln Park to purchase up to $500,000 worth of shares per transaction, with potential increases to $750,000 if the stock price exceeds $30, or $1 million if it exceeds $40.
The shares will be offered under Tonix’s effective shelf registration statement filed with the SEC on September 20, 2024, and declared effective on September 30, 2024. The company is not obligated to sell any shares under either agreement.
The significant stock dilution potential represented by these offerings appears to be driving today’s negative market reaction.

Investing.com -- Israel is considering taking military action against Iran in the coming days, according to ABC News. The news organization cited three sources familiar with the situation who provided details about the potential strike.
The sources indicated they were not aware of any specific U.S. role in an Israeli strike on Iran. They noted, however, that it remains possible the U.S. could provide logistical support and share intelligence with Israel that might be used for such an operation.
President Donald Trump on Wednesday said U.S. personnel were being relocated from the Middle East, describing it as a "dangerous place." The president also emphasized that the United States would not permit Iran to obtain a nuclear weapon, highlighting increased tensions in the region.
A senior Iranian official issued a warning on Wednesday, stating that Tehran would strike U.S. bases in the region if nuclear negotiations fail and conflict develops. This statement further escalates the already tense situation between the countries.
The potential Israeli military action comes amid growing concerns about regional stability and ongoing disputes over Iran’s nuclear program. Neither Israeli nor U.S. officials have publicly confirmed specific plans for military operations against Iranian targets.

Kelley Wolf, the former wife of actor Scott Wolf, was taken into police custody on Friday, 13 June, during a live video on her Instagram account.
The
clip
, which began with a black screen, captured Kelley’s voice as she said, “Oh my God. Don’t. Oh my God, this is not happening,” before the camera briefly showed her standing beside two police officers.
The officers told Kelley she was “not going to jail” but that they wanted to “get [her] some help” after she allegedly made “comments to your dad and comments to people that are concerning.”
Kelley Wolf replied, “I know what I’m doing, I’ve done this. This is my job.” A sound like handcuffs could be heard, and she added, “This is shameful, gentlemen. Be ashamed of yourselves.”
View this post on Instagram
A post shared by KELLEY WOLF (@kelleywolf)
Kelley then noticed her phone was still recording. She said she “didn’t mean to” leave the video running and asked that it be switched off. The recording ended with a quick shot of Kelley Wolf flanked by the officers.
The incident comes three days after Kelley announced her separation from her husband of 21 years,
Party of Five
actor Scott Wolf.
Read More:
Dakota Johnson spills relationship deal-breaker after Chris Martin split
In a statement on 10 June, Kelley Wolf said the split was “a long, quiet journey for me—rooted in hope, patience, and care for our children.”
Scott Wolf, who has filed for divorce, called the decision “the most difficult of my life” and asked for privacy as they guide their children—Jackson, Miller and Lucy—through “this new chapter.”
Police have not released further details about why Kelley Wolf was detained or whether she faces any charges. For now, the focus remains on Kelley Wolf’s welfare and the wellbeing of her family as they navigate a period of significant upheaval.

ISLAMABAD: Prime Minister Muhammad Shehbaz Sharif has instructed all concerned officials to ensure the unharmed return and protection of Pakistani pilgrims in Iran at the moment.
Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif has highlighted that prompt and efficient measures must be taken to ensure the protection of all Pakistani pilgrims in Iran.
Shehbaz Sharif has directed the Ministry of Foreign Affairs and the Pakistani diplomatic mission in Iran to be vigilant until the situation stabilises.
As a result of the intensifying regional situation, a Crisis Management Cell has been established at the Ministry of Foreign Affairs to monitor developments and coordinate assistance efforts.
Instructions have been given to the Pakistani Embassy in Iran to remain alert and advocate for Pakistani pilgrims in Iran.
Authorities have estimated the presence of approximately 5,000 Pakistani pilgrims currently in Iran, with many not in immediate contact with embassies or consulates.
The officials have recommended that pilgrims reconsider travel plans to Iran and Iraq due to security issues.
Read More:
Iran appoints new army chief, IRGC commander amid ongoing Israeli strikes
The situation in Iran has intensified significantly following extensive airstrikes carried out by Israel, which targeted main installations such as nuclear facilities, ballistic missile manufacturing sites, and military leadership.
In response, Iran has officially called for an emergency meeting of the United Nations Security Council, urging prompt and decisive actions against what it terms Israel’s military aggression.
Reports indicate that around 200 Israeli fighter jets have conducted strikes on more than 100 locations across Iran, including the Natanz nuclear facility.
The Iranian Revolutionary Guards Corps has confirmed the assassination of Hossein Salami, a prominent military commander, while several civilian casualties, including children, have been reported in Tehran.
United Nations Secretary-General António Guterres has called for maximum restraint to prevent further escalation of the conflict.
Simultaneously, leaders from Europe, including those from Germany, France, and the United Kingdom, have convened to discuss the crisis, underscoring the need for diplomatic intervention.
Pakistan is actively monitoring the evolving situation and is committed to providing necessary support and assistance to Pakistani pilgrims in Iran during this critical period.

content: Jharkhand Man Kills Wife By Pushing Her From Moving Train, Tries To Pass It Off As Accident Last Updated: June 14, 2025, 11:11 IST A man from Jharkhand was arrested for allegedly pushing his wife, Juhi Devi, to death from a moving train. He has been sent to judicial custody. (Representative Image/File) A man from Jharkhand was arrested for allegedly pushing his wife to death from a moving train and trying to pass it off as an accident, police said. The victim has been identified as Juhi Devi (24). According to police, Juhi Devi’s body was found near Tori-Chetar station in Latehar district on Thursday. News agency PTI, citing police, reported that the 24-year-old’s death was not accidental as was initially suspected, but a well-planned murder by her husband, Mahadev Singh. Following Devi’s death, Singh lodged a report at the Dhurki police station in Garwah, his home district, claiming that his wife had fallen off the train accidently. Therefter, police began an investigation. However, during probe, the accused broke down and confessed killing her. The husband admitted to pushing his wife from the running train which led to her death, PTI, citing Randhir Singh, the officer-in-charge of the Chandwa police station, reported. It was learnt that a family dispute was the reason that led Mahadev to take the extreme step. He was remanded to judicial custody by a court on Friday. Man Pushes Wife Off Roof, She Dies In a similar incident in February, a man in Haryana allegedly pushed his wife off the roof of their house, leading to her death. Subsequently, the husband and two others were arrested on murder charges. The deceased was identified as Ritu. It had come to light that Ritu was killed over a family dispute and her husband tried to pass the incident off as an accident, However, the probe revealed that the woman was pushed off the roof intentionally. Ritu’s brother had alleged that the husband, along with family members, had thrown her down, causing her death. Thereafter, police registered a case based on his complaint. A case was registered under section 101 (murder) and 61 (criminal conspiracy) of BNS. Manisha Roy Manisha Roy is a Senior Sub-Editor at News18.com's general desk. content: JSW MG Motor Celebrates Sixth Anniversary In India, Launches Limited Time Offer On ZS EV Last Updated: June 14, 2025, 11:03 IST The company has brought down the price range. It now starts at Rs 16.75 lakh (ex-showroom), making it more accessible to the masses in the country. MG ZS EV. (Photo: Manav Sinha/News18.com) The top carmaker in India, JSW MG Motor, finally completed 6 years in its business operations in India. The company celebrated its sixth anniversary by introducing a limited-time, exciting offer on its tech-loaded offering, ZS EV. The company has brought down the price range. It now starts at Rs 16.75 lakh from 16.88 lakh (ex-showroom), making it more accessible to the masses in the country. Price Range According to the details shared by the brand, interested customers can enjoy the price cut offer across the range. The top model can be purchased at Rs 20.49 lakh, witnessing the price cut of Rs 4,44 lakh. The battery-powered model is available in four trims named Executive, Excite Pro, Exclusive Plus, and Essence. Here;s What To Official Says Reacting to the newly launched deal, Rakesh Sen, Head of Sales, JSW MG Motor India, said, “To commemorate our 6th anniversary in India, we have made the MG ZS EV even more accessible for customers looking to upgrade to a stylish electric SUV. Our other two EVs are already at an accessible price point, and with this special pricing, the ZS EV will also attract customers seeking a premium ride. We remain confident that with an attractive overall packaging and pricing, the MG ZS EV will surely captivate Indian car buyers." In addition, he said, “The foundation of the company is based on innovation, and the ZS EV stands as a true testament of what the MG brand was truly capable of back in 2020. It was a car that redefined traditional mobility with the inclusion of tech-driven innovations." Battery and Range Under the hood, the MG ZS EV is powered by a 50.3 kWh Lithium-ion battery. It offers an impressive range of 461 km on a single charge. Once drained, the EV can be fully charged with an AC charger, and takes 8.5 to 9 hours, while the DC takes only 60 minutes. Investing.com -- British shares were mostly flat at the open on Thursday after official data showed that the country’s gross domestic product shrank by 0.3% in April, partially offsetting the 0.7% expansion recorded in the first quarter.
.As of 0715 GMT, the blue-chip index
FTSE 100
gained 0.01% and the British
GBP/USD
fell 0.07% against the dollar to above 1.35.
Meanwhile,
DAX
index in Germany dropped 0.8%, the
CAC 40
in France dipped 0.5%.
U.K. economy contracts in April
The U.K. economy experienced a notable decline in April, weighed down by rising energy costs and increased taxes.
According to data from the Office for National Statistics, gross domestic product fell by 0.3% during the month, a steeper drop than the anticipated 0.1% and a partial reversal of the 0.7% growth recorded in the first quarter.
On a yearly basis, GDP rose 0.9%, easing from the previous month’s 1.1% gain.
Tesco
reports Q1 sales growth
Tesco PLC (LON:
TSCO
) posted a 5.5% rise in group like-for-like sales for the first quarter of its 2025-26 fiscal year, driven by solid performance across its businesses in the U.K., Republic of Ireland, Booker, and Central Europe.
Total group sales, excluding fuel and VAT, reached £16.38 billion for the 13-week period ending May 24.
Halma
exceeds profit expectations
U.K. engineering firm Halma PLC (LON:
HLMA
) posted stronger-than-expected results for the fiscal year ending March 31, with adjusted pretax profit up 16% to £459.4 million and revenue rising 11% to £2.25 billion.
These figures beat analyst forecasts, and the company’s EBIT margin improved to 21.6%.
Halma said fiscal 2026 has started well, projecting upper single-digit organic revenue growth and margins slightly above the midpoint of its 19%–23% target range.
Wood Group extends Sidara takeover deadline
John Wood Group
PLC (LON:
WG
) has granted Sidara more time to decide on a potential takeover, extending the deadline to make a firm bid or withdraw from the process to June 30.
The extension allows Sidara to further develop its offer for the engineering consultancy.
Crest Nicholson
posts steady H1 results
Crest Nicholson Holdings plc (LON:
CRST
) posted encouraging results for the first half, signaling that its updated strategic approach is yielding positive outcomes amid evolving conditions in the housing market.
The company completed 739 homes during the first half of 2025, including those from joint ventures, marking a 6% decline from the previous year. Private sales, including bulk transactions, dropped to 107 units, down 40% from 177 in the same period last year.

Investing.com -- Polish fashion retailer LPP on Thursday reported a 20% year-on-year increase in first-quarter net profit, reaching 334 million zlotys ($90.49 million), which exceeded analyst expectations of 246 million zlotys.
The company’s operating profit grew by almost 13% year-on-year to 464 million zlotys during the quarter. LPP also saw its gross margin improve to 54.0%, representing a 1.9 percentage point increase compared to the previous year.
The strong financial performance was attributed to higher like-for-like sales and continued growth in the company’s online retail channel. Favorable exchange rate movements also contributed to the profit increase.
In April, LPP unveiled its 2025-2027 strategy, which outlines ambitious expansion plans. The company aims to double its annual revenue to 40 billion zlotys by 2027, with its Sinsay brand expected to generate 75% of the group’s total sales.
As part of this growth strategy, LPP plans to significantly expand its retail presence by increasing its store network to approximately 7,500 outlets by the end of 2027.

Star Australia batter Steve Smith walked off the field after suffering a finger injury while attempting a catch an edged ball from South Africa captain Temba Bavuma during the WTC final 2025.
The incident took place on Day 3 of the ultimate Test at Lord’s as South Africa chase a 282-run target.
Steve Smith was stationed close at the slip when South Africa captain Temba Bavuma edged a ball off pacer Mitchell Starc.
However, the Australia batter dropped the catch, giving an important reprieve to the South Africa captain in the second inning of the WTC final 2025.
The drop also caused Australia to suffer an injury scare as Steve Smith was seen visibly in pain.
Read more:
Sana Mir rings iconic Lord’s bell to open Day 2 of WTC final
Consequently, the Australia batter walked off the field and began the final session of the day off the field to receive further treatment.
View this post on Instagram
A post shared by ICC (@icc)
“Smith currently being assessed in the dressing room. Likely to go for scans,” Cricket Australia said via a statement.
Meanwhile, Aiden Markram remained unbeaten on 59 alongside Temba Bavuma (33)* as they need 156 runs to win the WTC final 2025.
Australia’s hopes looked more realistic but South Africa were making a fight of chasing a daunting target of 282 to win, reaching 126-2 at the time of writing this story.

Google is preparing a range of “Pixelsnap” accessories for the Pixel 10 that support wireless charging.
Despite Qi2 support, the phone may require the use of a case to add the magnets needed for alignment.
In addition to Google’s own accessories, look for a range of similar Made by Google solutions from third parties.
What is so hard about giving Android users what they want? When it comes to wirelessly charging our phones, we’re not asking for that much: just some proper
MagSafe-style Qi2 charging
with integrated magnets. And with our discovery earlier this week of Google’s work towards a new line of
“Pixelsnap” accessories,
we were getting cautiously optimistic that the Pixel 10 series might just be the phones to do it, supporting Qi2 magnetic attachment right out of the box. Sadly, that dream may already be over, as a new report emerges to dash our hopes.
A frustratingly recurring motif for wireless charging on Android phones has been the absence of magnets required for securely attaching Qi2 chargers with perfect alignment when it comes to phones themselves. Instead, manufacturers like Samsung have required users to
pick up a case for their phone with these magnets
, and while that works in a pinch, it’s far less convenient than having that support baked-in.

OPINION
My dad was a beloved bartender and sheriff. He was also an alcoholic. | Opinion
It took me 35 years to understand Dad and Mom suffered from a disease, not a moral weakness.
Jane Hillstrom
Special to Milwaukee Journal Sentinel
The author's father was an alcoholic who didn't fit the stereotypical image of a town drunk.
Alcoholism is a serious disease affecting the brain, often leading to health complications and relapse.
The author struggled with her father's alcoholism and only later understood it as a disease, not a moral failing.
Societal stigma surrounding alcoholism prevents effective support and understanding for those struggling with the disorder.
If you or a loved one struggle with addiction, help is available by calling 1-800-662-HELP.
To see whether your pattern of alcohol use puts you at risk for
alcohol use disorder
, please visit Rethinking Drinking at:
rethinkingdrinking.niaaa.nih.gov
Listen to yourself.
“She’s an alcoholic.”
“He’s a drunk.”
Equivalent to a loser. A bum. A failure.
Those with
alcohol use disorder
are stigmatized by our tone of inferiority. We turn our noses at their actions. We believe they are less than us. In truth, they have partners and spouses who love them, children who rely on them and co-workers who brainstorm with them. Our historical disdain and distance are juxtapositioned with love. That makes it difficult to help them.
When I was 13 years old, our green "princess" phone rang like a chorus of birds on high speed. I stretched the tangled, spiral cord around the corner into the living room ready to settle in next to the World Book Encyclopedias.
“Hello,” my voice squeaked.
“Your father is a drunk. He’s going to lose.” Click. The man on the phone sounded like Alfred Hitchcock, deep and disturbing. The call came in during Dad’s re-election campaign for county sheriff.
My dad didn't fit stereotype of town drunk in Western films
On TV shows, drunks stumbled and fell into ditches. They drank out of bottles inside crumpled paper bags and spent the night in jail to sleep it off. Drunks couldn’t hold jobs. They threw things across the room. Every Western had one town drunk who donned a scraggily beard, needed a bath and stumbled through the swinging doors of the saloon.
That wasn’t my dad. He wore an ironed, white short-sleeved shirt, tie and black pants to work. In no way could he be a drunk.
But he was.
After being a bartender for 25 years and undersheriff for four, my dad was elected Manitowoc County sheriff, which borders Lake Michigan halfway between Milwaukee and Green Bay. As a nine-year-old girl, I mixed three martinis for Dad each night after he came home from chasing criminals. After dinner, he mixed his own cocktails.
Later in his life, I admitted him to the hospital six times to detox. In addition, he entered a 30-day in-patient treatment center twice. One counselor wrote Dad was admitted to treatment “under pressure from his family because of what he called a little drinking problem.” Even Dad didn’t believe he could be a drunk.
Alcoholics have myriad of health issues, many relapse frequently
Alcoholism is a serious disease. According to the
National Institute on Alcohol Abuse and Alcoholism
, people with alcoholism have a brain disorder. It can be mild, moderate or severe like heart disease or diabetes. Without help, people are sentenced to an earlier death from cancer or damage to the liver and heart. Long-term sobriety of individuals who misuse alcohol involves behavioral therapy, support groups, and/or medications.
Seventy percent
relapse.
Dad relapsed again and again. Each time he detoxed he wore a straitjacket tied to the hospital bed due to life-threatening delirium tremens from alcohol withdrawal. Doses of Librium to mitigate seizures calmed his nervous system, but he screamed and yelled at imaginary spiders on his legs. After being sober for a month, Dad’s brain told him to keep drinking.
If alcohol abuse really is a brain disorder, why do we joke about it? U.S. Secretary of Defense Pete Hegseth’s allegations of alcohol abuse made him the butt of jokes on late night TV. We seem to be more empathetic to an individual’s health condition if the disease doesn’t cause slurring, stumbling, anger or crossing the centerline. If someone goes into a 30-day treatment center and relapses a few months later, do we hold the same empathy for this person as we do for someone whose cancer reoccurs?
The
National Institute on Alcohol Abuse and Alcoholism
cites three factors that increase the risk for
alcohol use disorder
:
Drinking at an early age. Those who begin drinking before age 15 are the most at risk. Dad started drinking at age 14.
Genetics and family history. Hereditability accounts for 60%. Eight people in my extended family died from alcohol-related problems.
Mental health and a history of trauma. Risk increases for people with depression, ADHD and PTSD.
Though a serious illness, alcoholism surrounded by stigma
Access, genetics and trauma. We stigmatize people who get dealt a bad hand. Do we hold the same disregard for a person who grows up without access to fresh vegetables, has a genetic predisposition to breast cancer and suffers childhood trauma from losing a parent? Access, genetics and trauma. Try saying, “She’s a cancer patient” in the same tone of, “She’s a drunk.” It doesn’t work.
Everyone knows someone who misuses alcohol, especially in Wisconsin, the
drunkest state
. With 28 million alcoholics in the U.S., people function invisibly in every career. According to the
Addiction Center
, jobs with the highest rates of addiction to alcohol include 20% of lawyers, 16.5% of oil and construction workers, 15% of doctors, 12% of restaurant workers and 10% of priests.
With drinking on the rise among
women
, there’s likely a high percentage for the career called "carpool driver." Because many people with the disease are functioning adults, they live unbothered and invisible until the effects on their body of prolonged and/or excessive drinking show up and also damage those they love.
When Dad lost re-election, my parents reopened their small-town tavern. Customers loved my dad. They remind me how when he laughed, he flicked his head and eyes to the upper right as if joy ran through his body so rapidly, he needed to release it to the atmosphere. They share stories of him throwing their dollar bill in the air and having it stick to the ceiling or how he extravagantly decorated the backbar for holidays.
It took me years to understand the disease my parents suffered from
Mom also drank excessively. She became severely depressed, went through alcohol withdrawal, developed
Korsakoff Syndrome
and lost her brilliant mind. Dad sought medical care from doctors, hospitals and in-patient facilities to get better. Medication for alcoholism hadn’t been invented.
Thirty years ago, it took a colossal amount of willpower to recover. I never gave Dad credit for his effort to get better because he never did. Instead, I abandoned him like his illness commanded him to abandon our family. His alcohol use disorder made it difficult for us to love him. For a time, I hated him. I secretly hurt reading social media posts about wonderful fathers every Father’s Day.
It took me 35 years to understand Dad and Mom suffered from a disease, not a moral weakness. Learning to express empathy rather than disgust for those who suffer from the disorder came from intensive self-reflection through therapy and the conclusion that in the game of life, everyone tries. Once I stopped inserting repulsion into the narrative whenever I said, “My parents were alcoholics,” people’s faces softened, and so did my heart.
Alcohol can make a person do bad things, such as drunk driving or domestic abuse. An alcoholic may disappoint, hurt and abandon those they love but their actions and disease do not inherently destroy what initially made many people love them. An understanding and acceptance of alcohol use disorder as a widespread disease is the first step we need to help those we love.
Jane Hillstrom
is a former public relations executive. She writes literary nonfiction and is completing a memoir about her childhood growing up in a tavern. She writes on Substack under The Osman Club, her parent’s tavern.

A leftist critique of top-heavy public institutions
More investment in the actual laborers will better serve everyone.
By
Christina Lieffring
●
Microtones
,
Politics
●
June 6, 2025
More investment in the actual laborers will better serve everyone.
This is our newsletter-first column, Microtones. It runs on the site on Fridays, but you can get it in your inbox on Thursdays by signing up for our email newsletter.
In a 2015 interview, Ira Glass, founder of the popular radio show and podcast
This American Life
, talked about why he asked his employers, WBEZ Chicago, to lower his income.
Sponsor
“[A]nd I just felt like, ‘I don’t know, it seems weird to be making this much money and asking people to donate money,’ It seemed unseemly,”
Glass told Kansas City public radio station KCUR
. “So I said, ‘I think that I should just make less.’ I just thought it … seemed fair. It seemed like I should make what you make if you’re like, a high school principal or something. Not even the principal, but the assistant principal.”
By contrast, UW-Madison Chancellor
Jennifer Mnookin earns $900,000
per year. With merit raises and retention bonuses, Mnookin could
earn over $1 million
in 2025.
Sponsor
It’s easy to pick on Mnookin’s outlandish salary, but an uncomfortable truth with our public institutions is that many are top-heavy. The bulk of their funds go to the bloated salaries of administrators. And while some administration is necessary to run an organization, those institutions and the administrators themselves have to know somewhere deep down that most of those positions are
bullshit jobs
. And anyone who thinks administration is harder or more stressful than teaching a classroom all day or driving a bus is kidding themselves.
After he was appointed, one of former Metro Transit General Manager Justin Stuehrenberg’s first initiatives was to create four new “chief” positions, three of which were placed in the City’s highest salary designation. Instead of promoting from within, Stuehrenberg hired new people and, in addition to their high salaries, they received
paid moving expenses
in excess of what the City allows. All three of those chiefs are no longer with Metro Transit and, unsurprisingly, did not solve the department’s problems. Because
the problems at Metro Transit
do not stem from a lack of administration, but from a lack of drivers and mechanics—the people who actually do the essential work.
For people who are not fascists or at least support the existence of public institutions, it feels risky to say this critique out loud as right-wing extremists continue their ongoing onslaught on any and all public goods. The distinction is that the right doesn’t want public goods to exist or to be available to the public, and there’s nothing those institutions could say or do that would change their position. What I’m critiquing is not the existence of those institutions—I want good schools, public health, public transit, etc.—but those institutions failing to meet the values inherent to their mission and to public service in general. It’s much harder for an institution to provide quality public services when the bulk of their money is going to bloat at the top instead of the people doing the actual work.
The right also does not want public jobs to be good jobs; former Gov. Scott Walker demonstrated that by undermining the power of public unions (except, of course, for cops). Walker hoped governments would seize the opportunity to race to the bottom and pay their employees as little as possible. Of course, those changes affected the salaries of people at the bottom rungs of the ladder, but not those at the top who make budget and salary decisions. As a result, our public institutions’ income distributions are mirroring the income gap we see in our society at large.
We should be able to hold our institutions to a higher standard, because we are paying for them. I do not want the bulk of our tax dollars to go to administrators who earn five to 10 times more than the actual workers—teachers, maintenance, custodians, drivers—who make the institution function. I want institutions and institution leaders who value their workers enough to not just say it but to
show
it with an income distribution that matches the needs and values of the organization. And I want the public, including students, to be able to affordably access those services.
The neoliberal argument for those high wages has been that these public institutions have to “compete with the private market.” But there has always been a tradeoff with public vs. private jobs. Public jobs pay less but provide better benefits, more stability (although that is TBD, thanks to the Trump administration) and the opportunity to work to provide a public good. Private positions pay more, but you often have to deal with potential layoffs and more meager benefits.
“But then Mnookin and others would go elsewhere to earn more.”
OK, let her. For a fraction of what she earns, I’m sure we can find someone else who would
value UW-Madison’s educators and researchers
, and who would not call the
cops on peaceful student protesters
, nor waste university funds on consultants and tech. A million dollars is enough to buy a house in Madison with cash and still live a perfectly comfortable life. Meanwhile, the teachers, staff, students, and taxpayers are struggling to make ends meet. Anyone who actually values the institution, the people who make it run, and the value it brings to the public would see how unseemly that is, and change it.
Who has power in Madison,
and what are they doing with it?
Help us create fiercely independent politics coverage that tracks power and policy.
Author
Christina Lieffring
Christina Lieffring is Tone Madison’s News and Politics Editor, a free-wheelin’ freelancer and lifelong Midwesterner. She is also the author of the
“No Final Drafts”
newsletter about “how we got here and how we could imagine a different world.”

ASX dips as gold, energy stocks soar after Iran attack
By
Staff reporter
Updated
June 13, 2025 — 5.27pm
first published at
5.15am
